{"reason": "Rows with inventory-days 10-13.2 waste 45000 since regular-lead <= 8 lets monitor arrive first (cost 0); rows at 2.8 and 5.3 days stock out via late alt-supplier (195000). I bounded the supplier branch to inventory-days < 8 and widened alert-planner (always on time, 35000) to medium risk below 6 days.", "source": "(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 6))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (< inventory-days 8))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
